idea-plugin.name: MCU Live Watch
idea-plugin.description:
Read global variables from a running MCU over a J-Link probe without halting the target.

The plugin parses the ELF file of the project, lets you pick symbols, and streams their values into a table and a live chart. Sampling rate is configurable per variable, so a fast-changing value and a slow counter can be watched at the same time.

Currently implemented for Arm Cortex-M targets debugged through SEGGER J-Link in CLion.
